tools.name: OpenAI API
tools.free_tier: None for API (Only $5 initial credit for some new accounts, expires in 3 months)
tools.hidden_cost: Heavy TPM (Tokens Per Minute) tier locks require depositing hundreds of dollars in prepay to upgrade limits

pricing.note: Pay-as-you-go per 1M tokens. Price it by your token volume in the AICost calculator.

tools.name: Anthropic Claude API
tools.free_tier: $5 free credit upon phone verification
tools.hidden_cost: 200K context window gets expensive rapidly if Prompt Caching is not implemented

pricing.note: Pay-as-you-go per 1M tokens. Price it by your token volume in the AICost calculator.

tools.name: DeepSeek API
tools.free_tier: 5M free tokens for new accounts
tools.hidden_cost: Frequent peak-hour 429 / 503 rate limits due to overwhelming global demand

pricing.note: Pay-as-you-go per 1M tokens (R1 output $2.19/M). Price it by your token volume in the AICost calculator.

tools.name: Groq LPU Inference
tools.free_tier: Generous free tier (up to 30 requests/min on Llama 3.3 70B)
tools.hidden_cost: Free tier is subject to strict daily token ceilings (e.g. 100k-500k tokens/day)

pricing.note: Pay-as-you-go per token with a generous free tier. Price it by your token volume in the AICost calculator.

tools.name: Supabase
tools.free_tier: 2 free projects, 500MB database, 1GB storage, 2GB bandwidth (pauses after 7 days of inactivity)
tools.hidden_cost: Database automatically pauses on Free tier after 1 week without active queries

pricing.note: Pro $25/mo per project, plus compute / egress / storage overages. PITR add-on is $100/mo.

tools.name: Neon Serverless Postgres
tools.free_tier: 0.5GB data storage, 1 project, 100 CU compute hours/month
tools.hidden_cost: Cold start latency (~500ms - 1s) when database wakes up from 0 compute units

pricing.note: Launch $19/mo, plus compute-unit hours, storage and written-data overages.

tools.name: Google Firebase
tools.free_tier: 1GB storage, 50k reads/day, 20k writes/day
tools.hidden_cost: The infamous 'Infinite Loop Read Disaster': an un-memoized React hook can trigger millions of reads and a $1,000+ overnight bill

pricing.formula: $0 Spark plan, or pay-as-you-go Blaze (per read / write / delete).
pricing.example: Blaze has no hard spend cap, only alerts. An un-memoized read loop can bill $1,000+ overnight.
pricing.note: The classic surprise-bill risk in this index. Cap usage with billing alerts.

tools.name: Vercel
tools.free_tier: 100GB bandwidth, serverless execution limits, strictly non-commercial use only
tools.hidden_cost: Hobby tier terms officially ban commercial sites (monetized blogs/SaaS)

pricing.note: Pro $20/user/mo, plus Fast Data Transfer $0.15/GB and Fast Compute overages.

tools.name: Cloudflare Pages & Workers
tools.free_tier: Unlimited bandwidth, 500 builds/month, 100k Workers requests/day
tools.hidden_cost: Edge runtime does not support standard Node.js native binary packages without polyfills

pricing.note: Pages free tier $0 (unlimited bandwidth). Workers Paid $5/mo for 10M requests.

tools.name: Railway
tools.free_tier: $5 one-time credit (no permanent free tier)
tools.hidden_cost: Background worker memory leaks will quietly max out RAM and inflate monthly usage bills

pricing.note: $5/mo Hobby or $20/mo Pro, plus exact vCPU/RAM usage per minute. No permanent free tier.

tools.name: Render
tools.free_tier: Free web services spin down after 15 minutes of inactivity; free Postgres expires after 30 days
tools.hidden_cost: Free PostgreSQL database is strictly deleted after 30 days if not upgraded to $7/mo

pricing.note: Starter $7/mo per web service instance, plus $0.10/GB egress overages.

tools.name: Zapier
tools.free_tier: 100 tasks/month, 5 single-step Zaps only
tools.hidden_cost: Every single step in a multi-step Zap consumes 1 task (a 5-step automation with 200 runs consumes 1,000 tasks and triggers high overage fees)

pricing.example: Monthly billing is 33% more ($39.99). A 5-step Zap with 200 runs burns 1,000 tasks.
pricing.note: Task-count tier. Every step in a multi-step Zap consumes 1 task.

tools.name: Make (Integromat)
tools.free_tier: 1,000 operations/month, 2 active scenarios
tools.hidden_cost: Data iteration loops (e.g. processing 100 rows in a sheet) execute 100 individual operations in seconds

pricing.example: 1 operation = 1 module execution. Processing 100 spreadsheet rows burns 100 operations.
pricing.note: Operations-volume tier. Monthly billing costs more than the annual rate shown.

tools.name: n8n (Self-Hosted & Cloud)
tools.free_tier: Self-hosted Community Edition is 100% free with unlimited workflows and executions
tools.hidden_cost: Self-hosting requires maintaining a $5/mo VPS (Railway/Hetzner) and configuring SSL/backups

pricing.note: Cloud EUR20/mo (2,500 executions). Self-hosted Community is $0 plus roughly $5/mo for a VPS.

tools.name: Notion
tools.free_tier: Unlimited blocks for individuals, 5MB file upload limit, up to 10 guest collaborators
tools.hidden_cost: Notion AI is NOT included in Plus plans: costs an additional $8-$10/user/month

pricing.note: Plus plan. Notion AI is a separate $8-10/user/mo add-on, not included.

tools.name: Airtable
tools.free_tier: 1,000 records per base, 1GB attachments, up to 5 editors
tools.hidden_cost: Strict record limits: hitting 1,000 records on free forces an upgrade to $24/user/mo

pricing.note: Team plan. Every editor needs a paid seat; 1,000-record free-tier cap forces the upgrade.

tools.name: Perplexity AI
tools.free_tier: Unlimited standard queries, 5 Pro searches per day
tools.hidden_cost: API pricing for sonar models charges for both token count and search request frequency

pricing.note: Pro $20/mo per user, flat.

tools.name: Cursor AI Editor
tools.free_tier: 14-day Pro trial, then 50 slow requests/month
tools.hidden_cost: Fast request limit: 500 fast requests burns out in ~10 days of heavy coding

pricing.note: Teams plan $30/user/mo (since Oct 12, 2026). Pro is $20/mo for individuals.

tools.name: GitHub Copilot
tools.free_tier: 2,000 code completions and 50 chat requests per month
tools.hidden_cost: Workspace-wide refactoring and deep multi-file editing is limited compared to Cursor

pricing.note: Business plan $19/user/mo. Individual is $10/mo for solo use.

tools.name: Fly.io
tools.starting_price: $0 Free Allowance | Pay-as-you-go from $1.94/mo per VM
tools.free_tier: Free allowance covers small shared-cpu VMs (up to 3 shared-cpu-1x 256MB VMs)
tools.hidden_cost: Requires credit card entry to activate account even for free allowance

pricing.note: Pay-as-you-go from $1.94/mo per VM. Dedicated IPv4 is +$2/mo.

tools.name: DigitalOcean App Platform & Droplets
tools.free_tier: 3 free static sites hosted on App Platform forever; $200 60-day credit for new users
tools.hidden_cost: Bandwidth overage is cheap ($0.01/GB) but begins billing immediately if pooling threshold is breached

pricing.note: Basic Droplet $4/mo. App Platform from $5/mo; managed databases from $15/mo.

tools.name: PostHog
tools.starting_price: $0 Free Tier | Pay-as-you-go based on event volume
tools.free_tier: 1,000,000 events/month, 5,000 session recordings/month, unlimited feature flags
tools.hidden_cost: Session recording overages: exceeding 5,000 recordings can ramp up bills if sample rate isn't set

pricing.formula: $0 for the first 1M events/mo, 5,000 session recordings/mo, unlimited feature flags.
pricing.example: A product under 1M events/mo pays $0. Beyond that, pay-as-you-go with decaying unit cost.
pricing.note: Set a recording sample rate - replay overages ramp fast if you do not.

tools.name: Plausible Analytics
tools.free_tier: 30-day free trial (no permanent free cloud tier)
tools.hidden_cost: Going viral on Hacker News/Twitter can bump pageviews into a higher $19-$49/mo bracket

pricing.note: Growth $9/mo at 10k pageviews. Higher pageviews bump the tier ($19-49/mo).

tools.name: Resend
tools.free_tier: 3,000 emails/month, 100 emails/day limit, 1 sending domain
tools.hidden_cost: Free tier enforces a hard 100 emails/day cap (stops bulk onboarding bursts)

pricing.note: Pro $20/mo for 50,000 emails/mo. Free tier covers 3,000 emails/mo with a 100/day cap.

tools.name: Postmark
tools.free_tier: 100 test emails forever (strictly for developer staging)
tools.hidden_cost: Strict manual vetting process: new accounts undergo manual domain and compliance review

pricing.note: $15/mo for 10,000 emails/mo, then $1.80 per extra 1,000. No free production tier.

tools.name: Stripe
tools.free_tier: No monthly setup or maintenance fees; only pay when you make sales
tools.hidden_cost: International cards incur an extra +1.5% fee + 1% currency conversion fee

pricing.formula: 2.9% + $0.30 per successful card charge. No monthly fee.
pricing.example: On $10,000/mo of card volume: $290 + $0.30 per charge (about $320 on 100 charges).
pricing.note: International cards add +1.5% + 1% FX; Billing adds 0.5-0.8% on recurring volume; $15 per lost dispute.

tools.name: Lemon Squeezy (Merchant of Record)
tools.free_tier: No monthly fee, pay only upon making sales
tools.hidden_cost: 5% + $0.50 is significantly higher than direct Stripe (2.9% + $0.30) on low-ticket items

pricing.note: Merchant-of-record fee includes global tax handling. Shutting down Mar 31, 2027 - new signups closed.

tools.name: Gumroad
tools.starting_price: 10% flat fee per sale + payment processing fees
tools.free_tier: Free to list unlimited products, zero monthly subscription fees
tools.hidden_cost: Total take rate reaches approximately 13% - 15% once credit card processing is included

pricing.formula: 10% platform fee + card processing (~2.9-3.4% + $0.30) per sale. No monthly fee.
pricing.example: On $10,000/mo of sales: roughly $1,300-1,500 total take.
pricing.note: Total take rate reaches about 13-15% once processing is included.

tools.name: Google Gemini API
tools.free_tier: Flash models have a rate-limited free tier; Gemini 4 Argon / Carbon have NO free tier
tools.hidden_cost: Intro-price expiry: Gemini 4 Argon input/output double on Dec 1, 2026 ($2 to $4 input, $10 to $20 output per 1M); Gemini 3.8 / 3.6 Flash double on Jan 1, 2027 ($0.75 to $1.50, $3.75 to $7.50) — budgets set at launch rates silently double

pricing.note: Pay-as-you-go per 1M tokens. Flash rates double Jan 1, 2027 - re-base budgets before then.

tools.name: Harvest
tools.free_tier: 1 seat, 2 projects
tools.hidden_cost: The $9/seat headline is a floor, not the bill: a second meter charges for active projects, clients, tasks and invoices on top of seats — the bill grows when your client list grows, even if your team does not

pricing.note: Teams $9/user/mo annual ($11 monthly). A second, unpublished usage meter bills projects, clients, tasks and invoices on top.

tools.name: ActiveCampaign
tools.free_tier: None — no free plan; 1,000-contact minimum purchase
tools.hidden_cost: Contact tiers jump in steps, not linearly: Plus goes from $239/mo at 10,000 contacts to $329/mo at 15,000 (+38%), and Pro from $259 at 5,000 to $469 at 10,000 (+81%) — budget for the next tier, not the current one

pricing.note: Starter $19/mo at 1,000 contacts (monthly billing). Higher lists jump tiers: Plus $239/mo at 10,000 contacts, Pro $259/mo at 5,000 and $469/mo at 10,000. Seats, sends and CRM bill separately.

tools.name: Mixpanel
tools.free_tier: 1M events/month, 10K session replays/month, 1K experiment MEU/month, unlimited seats
tools.hidden_cost: Every tracked event counts, across all projects combined: at 5M events/mo the bill is $613/mo on monthly billing ($438/mo annual) — instrumentation sprawl and autocapture inflate the meter, not your user count

pricing.example: At 5M events/mo: $438/mo on annual billing, $613/mo on monthly billing (40% premium).
pricing.note: Events count across all projects combined. Session Replay and Experiments are separate meters.

tools.name: Mailchimp
tools.free_tier: 250 contacts, 500 sends/mo (max 250/day), 1 seat, 1 audience; sending pauses when limits are hit
tools.hidden_cost: Tiers jump in steps, not linearly: Essentials goes $13 (500 contacts) to $75 (5,000) to $385 (50,000); Standard $20 to $100 to $450; Premium is flat $350 up to 10,000 contacts, then $620 at 25,000 and $815 at 50,000 — all verified 2026-11-24 on mailchimp.com

pricing.note: Essentials monthly billing at verified contact anchors. Standard runs $20 / $100 / $450 and Premium $350 / $620 / $815 at the same contact levels. Overages auto-bill; intermediate tiers load dynamically on Mailchimp's pricing page.

tools.name: Jira (Atlassian)
tools.free_tier: Up to 10 users, 2 GB storage, 150 automation steps per site/month, 0 Rovo AI credits
tools.hidden_cost: The pricing page headline is a blended average, not your price: the default view shows Standard $8.48 and Premium $15.56 per user/month, a weighted average for a 300-user team. Teams of 1-100 users actually pay $9.70 (Standard) and $19.60 (Premium) on monthly billing, per Atlassian's official pricing tables effective Oct 13, 2026

pricing.note: Standard monthly $9.70/user for 1-100 users (Atlassian pricing tables, Oct 13, 2026). Per-seat rate falls with size ($5.80 at 2,501-5,000 users). Annual is sold in fixed user tiers, about 18% cheaper at the 10-user tier ($950/yr).
